experiment: Round9: one fixed balanced-batch and sample-normalization intervention
scope: Research only, using the same repeatedly inspected 141 validation Fridays in 2018-2020. No new prices, dates, labels, architectures, seeds, training epochs, sample deletion, or deployment. This is exploratory, not independent confirmation.
data: Byte-copy the previous full-history mature train and validation row arrays, round5 packed raw OHLCV125-bar windows and joint return/auxiliary labels. All unique training rows appear exactly once per epoch. The same NumPy permutation(seed) sequence is used in both rules. Return and auxiliary training-only mean/population SD are exactly the legacy full-history values.
model: Frozen research_v6.models6.make_model('combined', seed),38551 parameters. Two layers, d_model16/d_ff32, dropout0.3, AdamW and initialization unchanged; deterministic CUDA float32, TF32 off, existing GPU environment.
baseline: Reuse the nine archived full-history combined20 models and423 seed predictions. Legacy batches are consecutive slices of128 with a final partial batch; per-step loss is mean standardized return squared error plus0.1 times mean auxiliary squared error. The inherited last batches contain14,1,117 rows.
candidate: Exactly one candidate, balanced. Let N be full training rows and M=ceil(N/128). Split the same permutation into M consecutive chunks using numpy.array_split: chunk lengths differ by at most1. For chunk B use loss=(|B|*M/N)*(mean return squared error +0.1*mean auxiliary squared error). Thus, at fixed parameters, the average of M step losses equals the full-data mean objective, and every row has the same nominal coefficient M/N within an epoch. Batch sizes are119-120,120-121,127-128. Preserve N presentations, M optimizer steps,20 epochs, learning rate, weight decay and clipping. No dropped rows, repetition, padding or new samples.
attribution_limit: This single batching rule changes partition boundaries and loss normalization together; it does not isolate their separate contributions. Different batch shapes alter dropout RNG consumption and optimization trajectories even with the same seed. Equal nominal loss coefficients do not imply equal parameter influence under dropout, gradient clipping or AdamW.
budget: Nine new fits: three folds x three existing seeds, final epoch20 checkpoint only. Reuse nine old models. One training worker, no outcome-dependent extra fits or checkpoint selection. Replay all18 final models.
primary: Two paired weekly MSE comparisons of the new three-seed ensemble: versus frozen legacy ensemble and versus unchanged full-history training mean. Circular block bootstrap, block length8 observations,10000 replicates,seed20260910,centered two-sided p; Holm across these two comparisons. Also report percentile95% intervals, which need not invert the centered test. All results remain exploratory after repeated use of validation dates.
descriptive_screen: Report each flag: ensemble beats legacy MSE; ensemble beats training-mean MSE; at least2 of3 individual seeds beat training mean; at least2 of3 matched seeds beat legacy; at least2 of3 years beat legacy. Local screen passes only if all flags pass. Report every fold and seed, no best seed or year selection. This is not statistical confirmation.
training_only_probe: Before fitting, use three frozen legacy epoch20 states at seed20260910, one per fold. Disable dropout via eval mode, keep parameters fixed, and compare per-step raw gradients for both partitions of the first seed20260910 permutation. Report gradient norm distribution, vector variance, and deviation of the mean step gradient from the full-objective gradient. No optimizer step. This is a fixed-state mechanism diagnostic, not a measurement of stochastic training variance or causal proof of performance change.
diagnostics: Training-only nominal loss coefficient exposure over all20 orders for all9 paired fits; final training return/auxiliary MSE; raw pre-clipping gradient norms and clipping fractions for new fits (old dynamic norms unavailable); annual/seed validation metrics; complete-window cyclic reassignment within each validation fold; forecast standard deviation and sensitivity versus matched legacy predictions.
verification: Freeze prior evidence, source, protocol, inputs, masks, prediction reuse and fit plan. Check maturity, dates, exact row coverage/order/update counts and uniform nominal coefficients. Check the full-objective loss/gradient identity with unequal chunks and tensor/RNG parity with legacy on the divisible-batch special case. Freeze and replay the nine legacy references. Recompute all180 new epoch order and boundary hashes, scales, metrics, bootstrap tests, flags, and all18 checkpoint forecasts. Preserve every previous artifact.
